🧊 Liquid Argon Tank

Bulk tank, read as a % on the gauge — not tracked as bottles.

📐 Steel Count

Grouped by Plates, Tubing, and Flatbar — tap a section to open it. Starts from the last count you confirmed. Add a new size/type with "+ Add Item" at the bottom of its section. Nothing goes out until you tap Confirm & Queue.

🛞 Tyres Count

One flat list of sizes — starts from the last count you confirmed. Add a new size with "+ Add Item" at the bottom. Nothing goes out until you tap Confirm & Queue.

🧪 Mixing Room Count

Check the WhatsApp photo and adjust each row to match — starts from the last count you confirmed. Nothing goes out until you tap Confirm & Upload at the bottom.

🖨 Full Count

Tools for a full stock count — printing sheets, entering results, and syncing the reference numbers.

⚙ More

🗑 Retired Items

Removed from groups and search, but every past log entry for these stays exactly as it is. Restore any of them anytime.

📜 Spot Check History

Every count ever logged on this tablet, newest first. This never clears on sync — it's the permanent record.

👤 Who Did What

Every issue, count, and delivery logged on this tablet, newest first — who did it and when.

🖨 Full Stock Count Sheet

Every trackable item, split into pages of 30 — pick how many people are counting today and each one gets their own sheet.

+ Register a Vehicle

📋 Diesel Fill-Up History

In the order they happened, oldest first. A red flag means this fill-up's Start reading doesn't match the End of the one before it — worth checking for anything dispensed without being logged.

⛽ Diesel Request

Matches the paper Diesel Request slip — you'll still fill out the physical copy for the office to invoice. This just keeps stock levels and reorder points accurate.
Estimated Main Tank Level — tracked locally on this tablet, may drift from the laptop until synced

Rename / Move Item

Renaming only changes what shows on the tile — the real stock name stays the same underneath, for the master list and exports. Changing the group moves the tile to a different screen.

⚙ Manage Jobs

Mark finished jobs complete so they stop cluttering the search. Nothing is deleted — completed jobs still work if you type the exact job number.
